day_title: Записаться и открыть приём · Описать боль и понять назначение

phrases.speaker: role
phrases.description: The person at the desk asks this the moment you walk in.
phrases.example: Good morning — do you have an appointment with us today?
phrases.example_translation: Доброе утро — вы к нам сегодня записаны?
phrases.image_api_prompt: a receptionist in a clinic looking up at a visitor across a desk, close-up

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.transliteration: ай хэв эн эпойнтмент эт хаф паст найн
phrases.description: You say this to confirm the hour you were given.
phrases.example: Yes, I have an appointment at half past nine.
phrases.example_translation: Да, у меня приём в полдесятого.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a wall clock showing half past nine above a clinic reception desk

phrases.frame: I need to check in at ___.
phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.translation: Мне нужно отметиться на стойке в полдесятого.
phrases.transliteration: ай нид ту чек-ин эт хаф паст найн
phrases.description: You say this when the desk asks what time you were told to arrive.
phrases.example: I need to check in at half past nine, at the front desk.
phrases.example_translation: Мне нужно отметиться на стойке в полдесятого, у ресепшена.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a visitor giving his name at a reception counter, clinic lobby

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.description: You say this when someone spoke too fast and the words went past you.
phrases.example: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
phrases.example_translation: Извините, не могли бы вы повторить?
phrases.image_api_prompt: a visitor leaning slightly forward at a clinic desk, listening carefully

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.translation: Я пришёл из-за боли в спине.
phrases.transliteration: айм хиэ бикоз оф бэк пэйн
phrases.description: You say this in one sentence when someone asks what brought you in.
phrases.example: I'm here because of back pain, it started last week.
phrases.example_translation: Я пришёл из-за боли в спине, началось на прошлой неделе.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a man holding his lower back while standing at a clinic counter

phrases.speaker: role
phrases.description: The doctor asks this first, before anything else.
phrases.example: Where does it hurt — here, or lower down?
phrases.image_api_prompt: a doctor in a white coat pointing at a patient's back, clinic office

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.transliteration: ит хётс ин май лоуэр бэк
phrases.description: You say this to name the exact place, not the whole area.
phrases.example: It hurts in my lower back when I sit down.
phrases.example_translation: Болит в пояснице, когда я сажусь.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a patient pointing at his lower back while a doctor listens, clinic office

phrases.frame: It has been like this for ___.
phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.transliteration: ит хэз бин лайк зис фор э уик
phrases.description: You say this when a doctor asks how long the problem has lasted.
phrases.example: It has been like this for a week, maybe a bit longer.
phrases.example_translation: Так уже неделю, может, чуть дольше.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a desk calendar with seven days marked, on a doctor's desk

words.description: The part of your body just above the hips, at the back.
words.example: It hurts in my lower back, right here.
words.image_api_prompt: a simple anatomical view of a man's lower back area, no text

words.description: The feeling you go to a doctor about when your back is the problem.
words.example: I'm here because of back pain that started on Monday.
words.example_translation: Я пришёл из-за боли в спине, которая началась в понедельник.
words.image_api_prompt: a man sitting on a chair holding his back, plain room

words.example: It has been like this for a week now.
words.example_translation: Так уже неделю на этот момент.
words.image_api_prompt: seven paper squares in a row on a table, close-up

words.description: The moment thirty minutes after nine o'clock.
words.example: I have an appointment at half past nine, with the doctor.
words.example_translation: У меня приём в полдесятого, к врачу.
words.image_api_prompt: a round clock face showing thirty minutes past nine, close-up

chunks.description: To tell the desk you have arrived, so they know you are there.
chunks.example: I need to check in at ten.
chunks.example_translation: Мне нужно отметиться на стойке в десять.
chunks.image_api_prompt: a visitor handing his name at a hospital reception counter

chunks.description: Something that comes suddenly and feels like a cut, not a dull ache.
chunks.example: I'm here because of a sharp pain.
chunks.image_api_prompt: a man wincing suddenly while standing up from a chair
